purpose: Supplementary exploratory investigation of task sharing, held-out accuracy and generalization-gap proxies; not a retroactive confirmatory test.
original_results_policy: Read old v4 inputs only; do not execute archived modules at import time, modify old outputs, replace old checkpoints, relock old protocols or edit the thesis before results are checked.

data.strategy: Use existing chronological frozen splits as an explicitly exploratory supplement.
data.independent_confirmation: Would require a separately frozen chronological period not previously examined; not claimed by this draft.

capacity_rule.choice: Keep d_model, head count and layer count fixed; choose integer d_ff minimizing absolute parameter-count difference, with smaller d_ff as tie-break; no outcome-based search.
capacity_rule.limitation: Equal-width and approximately equal-budget comparisons are complementary controls; FF width changes in the budget arm and neither comparison proves a pure causal sharing effect.

training.batch_order: Same deterministic batch permutations for each paired seed across arms.
training.checkpoint_rule: Lowest original raw-scale combined validation score; earlier epoch breaks ties. Also report fixed final-epoch diagnostics.
training.test_access: No new test predictions until all nine selected checkpoints and the analysis settings are frozen.

primary_accuracy.return: Per-date absolute error averaged equally over the four assets, in raw units.
primary_accuracy.volatility: Per-date pinball(tau=0.5) loss averaged equally over the four assets, in raw units.

outcomes.gap_proxy: Held-out task loss minus training-evaluation task loss, using the same metric and model.eval() for both. Show both components, validation gap, histories and seed-level variation.
outcomes.seed_policy: Report every seed, mean and sample SD; primary loss series averages per-seed losses, rather than selecting the best seed or silently substituting an ensemble-forecast loss.
outcomes.planned_uncertainty: Paired date-level loss differences; Bartlett-HAC L=19, h=1 HLN t-reference, Holm over the four performance comparisons. Report lag-0 sensitivity and finite-lag limitations. Generalization-gap contrasts remain descriptive with three seeds.
outcomes.direction: Positive (NS loss - FS loss) means sharing has lower held-out loss.

interpretation.consistent_pattern: Both tasks show lower held-out error and smaller gap proxies, with per-seed and capacity-control results reported in full.
interpretation.mixed_pattern: Improvement restricted to one task, one control, or unstable across seeds is reported as mixed evidence.
interpretation.gap_caution: A small gap alone can reflect poor training fit or distribution shift; no claim that the reduction is exclusively overfitting or that a mediating mechanism has been proved.

next_gate: Fit all nine arm-seed jobs with the fixed 100-epoch budget, freeze selected/final checkpoint hashes and histories, independently verify the frozen gate, then evaluate once under the locked analysis.

preflight.pilot: One NS/seed123 epoch for code/timing only; excluded from all H2 results; no performance-driven settings change.

analysis.seed_loss_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-seed per-date losses, not ensemble forecast loss.
analysis.gap_inference: Descriptive means and sample standard deviations across three paired seeds; not a causal mediation test.
